originality.rationale: The uniform all-orbit single-edge simple-homotopy threshold is not implied by the inspected primary or nearest indexed mathematical claims. In particular, interior deleted arcs violate the directed cyclic graph hypothesis of the relevant 2015 preprint edge-deletion theorem, while the other inspected work concerns intact flag complexes or different graph families. value.rationale: An all-dimensional, all-edge-orbit threshold for exact simple-homotopy resilience in natural cyclic metric flag complexes, together with the precise and sharp p=2 obstruction. A robust inclusion map rather than a numerical Betti count is the main outcome; no downstream theorem is needed for this structural local-to-global collapse criterion.
